generator_view.scenario: A buyer wants a keyboard that can remain serviceable for roughly a decade and is comparing three products in a frozen shopping snapshot: the low-cost Punkston TK87, the hot-swappable RK100, and the detachable-cable CODE V3. They care more about replaceable failure points and available spares than marketing numbers, and they want long-use owner reports used cautiously rather than treated as population reliability data.
generator_view.target: Audit the frozen product listings, component mechanisms, repair and spare-part risks, and mixed long-use reports. Decide whether any current option is actually decade-proven; if not, identify the most defensible current-shopping fallback and state the checks that still gate a purchase without converting component ratings or anecdotes into a whole-board guarantee.

query: I want a keyboard with decade serviceability priority. Compare all three frozen product options and these four routes: the Punkston low price switch rating route, the RK100 repairability first current buy, the CODE V3 detachable cable fixed switch route, and the defer or use longitudinal reference route. Audit the complete frozen product bodies for exact price, displayed review aggregate, keycap material, switch-cycle wording, hot-swap compatibility, included replacement switches, detachable or included cable, and whether same-model long-term evidence is present. Treat these as hard requirements: separate switch cycle claims from whole board lifetime; separate keycap wear from electronics failure; audit switch cable keycap and PCB repair paths; and verify warranty and spare part availability. Explain what the generic contact, debounce, and hot-swap mechanisms do and do not establish. Reconcile the mixed Unicomp reports, the NYM96 daily-driver report, the older secondhand Logitech report, and the PCB-failure report while enforcing that owner reports are scoped anecdotes rather than population reliability data. Remember that seller claims are not independent durability tests, and do not claim a decade winner without same model longitudinal support. Decide whether any current option is decade-proven; if none is, identify the most defensible current-shopping fallback and the checks that still gate purchase. Cite each factual claim to its sandbox source.
